name: 35207-longrewrite-qwen8b-1gpu
workload: long-document copy-edit, 200 arXiv excerpts, 9000 prompt tokens pinned, 512 output tokens pinned per request
purpose: A copy-editing assistant rewriting 9,000-token research paper excerpts into 512-token passages for concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- the parser DROPS nested and indented lines, so a structured value must
# stay on one line or the engine starts without it.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-8B
tp-size: 1
speculative-algorithm: NGRAM
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 12
attention-backend: flashinfer
max-running-requests: 48
mem-fraction-static: 0.8
